description: Ordinary code facts that must survive the admitted hygiene pipeline byte-identical. Every entry is durable knowledge a coding agent should be able to remember; anything here that starts being redacted or withheld is a false positive.

cases.why: A 40-character git SHA is hex-only, so the entropy detector must not treat it as a token.
A 64-character hex digest pinned in a test fixture is a durable fact.
Hexadecimal literals and colour tables are hex-only.

payload.note: sentinels are 0xdeadbeefcafebabe and 0xfeedfacedeadbeef; the accent colour is #ff00aa

cases.why: Long CamelCase and snake_case identifiers have no digit, so the entropy detector must stay quiet.
token_budget, token_count, and token_limit are on the sanitizer's safe-metadata allowlist.
The word 'secret' in prose is not a credential.

payload.note: secret sauce of the planner is union-find over the candidate set

cases.why: A fixture-profile name that shares a credential prefix's letters but is not a token.

payload.note: Use the sk-test fixture profile for dry runs

cases.why: Configuration keys, cloud regions, and package names can begin with issuer-like prefixes without carrying credential material.
A documented default bind address is durable configuration knowledge, so the port class annotates rather than rewrites.
A stable, non-instance temporary location is a durable fact about where scratch output goes.
A UUID is hex with hyphens and carries no entropy signal.
The canonical shape of a durable user preference.

payload.note: Use pnpm rather than npm for installs in this repo

cases.why: Nesting, arrays, numbers, booleans, and nulls must all survive unchanged.

alternatives: a daemon plus a thin client

cases.why: Run-log phrasing inside a durable sentence annotates rather than rewrites.

payload.note: the incremental pass finished in 12.4s on the reference machine
